versions.Name: Initial release with comprehensive Starwind UI component reference
Notes: Added complete Starwind UI component library integration
Created comprehensive AGENTS.md quick reference files for 11 components
Implemented dropdown, card, table, item, breadcrumb, sidebar, tabs, pagination, theme-toggle, aspect-ratio, and separator components
Added component documentation with usage patterns and API references
Configured Tailwind CSS v4 with custom theme variables
Set up project structure with layouts, styles, and utilities

versions.Name: Added comprehensive form component library with advanced features
Notes: Installed and documented 15 form components: Button Group, Checkbox, Combobox, Dropzone, Input, Input Group, Input OTP, Label, Native Select, Radio Group, Select, Slider, Switch, Textarea, Toggle
Created comprehensive documentation files for each component with usage examples, API references, and best practices
Generated agent-friendly AGENTS.md summaries for easy integration and development
Added fetch-component workflow for automated component installation and documentation
Implemented advanced features: search functionality, drag-and-drop, range sliders, synchronized toggles, OTP input with paste handling
Ensured full accessibility support with ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation
Added multiple variants (default, primary, secondary, info, success, warning, error) and sizes (sm, md, lg)
Implemented event-driven architecture for modern web applications
Updated package.json and starwind.config.json with new dependencies
